evidence: we created a library of nucleosomes incorporating biologically relevant modification signatures, including mono- and tri-methylation of lysine 4 of histone H3 (H3K4me1/3), di- and tri-methylation of lysines 9 and 27 of histone H3 (H3K9me2/3 and H3K27me2/3), di- and tri-methylation of lysine 20 of histone H4 (H4K20me2/3), varying degrees of acetylation of lysines (Kac), the histone variant H2A.Z or CpG-methylated DNA.
